knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Quality head to toe Hunt Attire for the whole family. We provide the best range of hunt kit using only the finest quality materials and made in the UK. We also stock Saddlery and all Hunt Accessories at incredible value for money. Established in 1983 we have developed our products from years of experience on the hunting field to ensure that all our kit is completely fit for purpose whilst completely in keeping with the traditional styling for hunting. We would be delighted to help with all your hunting needs. Please contact either Jill or Richard on sales@huntingstockmarket.co.uk We attend lots of equestrian and hound events throughout the year or appointments can be made to visit us in Stockbridge, Hampshire."
